approval_ref: The active user goal requires continued efficiency, accuracy and adaptability improvements for RFI, Submittal and Email content.
notes: An unnamed text/plain related resource is listed as importable but receives attachment-1 with no extension.
The imported document then routes to UNSUPPORTED instead of the TXT parser, breaking explicit attachment analysis.
Reuse Python's deterministic built-in MIME mapping for fallback extensions; do not infer or replace a supplied filename.
Unknown types may retain a non-analyzable extension and must not be treated as supported content.
640 Python, 24 UI and 11 deployment-boundary tests passed offline; an unnamed text/plain resource imports as attachment-1.txt and succeeds through the existing TXT parser.
title: Keep unnamed MIME imports analyzable
objective: Give unnamed MIME attachments a stable safe extension derived from their declared content type so explicitly imported supported resources can enter the existing parser without guessing unsupported content.
